text: Hail, Initiate! I hope your patrols have fared well.
source_text: Hail, Initiate! I hope your patrols have fared well.

text: Hold! If you have not spoken with our Captain yet, do so and then go!
source_text: Hold! If you have not spoken with our Captain yet, do so and then go!

text: Hold! I recognize you and I do not trust you. I give you fair warning: if you make trouble for us, you will be shot dead. Now move!
